intro.title: introduction
intro.description: hey, i’m nyuma! i write code, make music, and occasionally combine the two to make something cool. you might’ve seen my work at notion, or maybe caught me winning a hackathon or two. currently, i'm changing the way people with sickle cell disease manage their health. welcome to my little corner of the 'net.

app_development_club.achievements: led a team of over 200+ student developers in building web and mobile apps.;hosted a $2000 hackathon with 75+ participants, partnering with purs digital and oregon state university, challenging students to build an nfc-based mobile application in just 48 hours.;launched 5 apps, including an ai-platform that understands your course schedule, a peer-to-peer study group and tutoring platform for osu students, and a new club website.

notion.achievements: launched the notion device manager to over 10 million users, enabling log-in alerts, session management, and device tracking.;featured in the notion blog for innovative use of notion to manage the club's engineering, logistics, and community.;sparked a partnership between notion and colorstack, establishing a pipeline for underrepresented students to intern at notion.
